decks.summary: Fast main-cluever Bob for Easy and Standard: Old Keyrings and Flashlights for clues, Scavenging and Lucky Cigarette Case to recycle and draw, and Leo De Luca and Track Shoes to cover ground.
Two-box Bob who mills a junk pile with Short Supply and oversucceeds to Scavenge the items back, adding rare relics as he upgrades.
Tool-heavy Bob who straps on Tool Belts, Thieves' Kits and Flashlight (3), equips items for free with Joey "The Rat" Vigil, and clears enemies with Damning Testimony and Shed a Light.
Salesman Bob as a support clue finder: he pushes Lanterns, Old Keyrings and Pocket Telescope as fast plays, recycles them with Scavenging and Short Supply, and hands items to his partner.

Monster-slayer Bob who keeps the guns for himself: .45 Thompsons, .18 Derringers and Baseball Bats, Lonnie Ritter boosts, and Pushed to the Limit to fire from the discard pile, on the way to the Beretta M1918.
A YouTube Edge of the Earth Bob from the Revised Core, starter packs and Edge of the Earth: Old Keyrings, Scavenging and Schoffner's Catalogue, played beside a Lily Chen deck.
Spanish-language Core and Edge of the Earth Bob who finds clues fast with item support and Scavenging, avoids enemies, and uses .41 Derringers when things turn ugly.
Dark Horse Bob who stays broke while Crafty pays for Lanterns, Mariner's Compasses and trick events, gathering clues and slipping enemies with Bait and Switch and Ethereal Slip.
Bob built to pair with a matching Dexter Drake deck: he finds clues with Lanterns and Old Keyrings, recycles items with Scavenging, and plays and pays for Dexter's items.
A Revised Core and Edge of the Earth starter Bob built to share cards with four sibling starter decks: Baseball Bats and Knives, Flashlights, Schoffner's Catalogue and Professor Webb.
